question: Can we charge Tallowfield freight now outside Hexley Works, and on what basis?
expected_answer: May charge the Customer the cost of freight under the General Terms; the programme wording does not govern now.

question: What notice period applies now to Tallowfield's general supply relationship?
expected_answer: Six months under Amendment 1 effective 2026-02-01, replacing the General Terms' twelve-month notice.

question: Does the 2019 agreement still cover Tallowfield Industrie GmbH after the refit programme expired?
expected_answer: Yes: the German named affiliate may order under the General Terms; those continue after programme expiry and Amendment 1 confirms continuing purchases.

wrong_part_trap: Do not substitute general 30-day payment or expired refit programme terms.

question: Do we have a confirmed complete master governing Pellmont's trade, and what currently governs part of it?
expected_answer: No confirmed complete governing master: doc 004 is a tracked draft and doc 007 is a detached signed page whose execution text is missing; status remains unsure. Doc 006 governs the 2% rebate for 2026 only.

wrong_part_trap: Detached signatures do not authenticate the draft's commercial terms.

question: What payment period applies to Quenby's pump purchases now?
expected_answer: 21 days from invoice under the 2024 General Terms. The 2018 master is superseded and Schedule A's 10-day pump terms expired on 2024-12-31.
evidence_key: doc 012 p1 cl2/cl5; p2 A2/A3/A5; doc 011 cl4

question: What freight charge may we apply to Quenby now, including any cap?
expected_answer: Reasonable delivery expense capped at GBP 250 per consignment under the live General Terms.
wrong_part_trap: Freight included in the old master and expired Schedule A no longer applies.

question: Which accounts have a current exclusivity or sole-supplier commitment?
expected_answer: Quenby Marine Services only: sole supplier for all marine equipment purchases for the life of the General Terms.
evidence_key: doc 012 p1 cl7; doc 001 p1 cl10; doc 008 cl7
wrong_part_trap: Do not count expired/draft status or infer exclusivity from ordinary supply scope.

question: Which live arrangements have a fixed end date within twelve months after 2026-09-06?
expected_answer: Pellmont's 2026 Rebate Letter ends 2026-12-31 and Tallowfield's Hexley Works Site Agreement ends 2027-03-31. No other live arrangement has a fixed end date in this window.
wrong_part_trap: Exclude already-expired programme/NDA and rolling or superseded masters.

question: How many current governing agreements, including agreements governing only part of trade, are on the customer's paper?
expected_answer: Two: Tallowfield's Hexley Works Site Agreement (doc 008) and Quenby's 2024 Marine Supply Agreement (doc 012).
evidence_key: doc 008 cl2/cl3/cl4; doc 012 p1 cl4/cl8; doc 001 cl10; doc 006 cl4

question: Which accounts lack a confirmed agreement governing their trade as a whole?
expected_answer: Pellmont Logistics Group only. Its master remains unsure; its PO covers one purchase and rebate covers a period, neither establishing a full governing framework.
